svg.title: Compose HTML layout, provider sources, projected surfaces and input
svg.desc: HDR HTML frontend 0.2.2 with core 0.9.11 and scene 20 separates acquisition, layout, canvas ordering, surface mapping, input and effects. PB bind-screen uses an existing owned plane, cylinder, sphere, ellipsoid or mesh. Explicit visible nodes retain full content bounds and effective rectangular clips. Attach-source inserts a provider after a node background and before its children without stretching clipped UVs. The PB demo attaches a physical camera to div pov; Previous and Next HTML buttons change only that camera ID. Compatible Client Renderer 0.9.13 supplies PB camera capture and automatic persistent pointer. Native sprites use an owned physical SCRIPT/NONE LCD, opaque RGB and cooperative input; partial source alpha and overlap with later visible artwork are rejected. Local CreateSurface and cooperative world-ray input use the same mapper; local native sources need an actual anchor and the negotiated Client Renderer 0.9.14 service. Readiness and server publication do not prove live viewer or GPU acceptance. No implicit script execution, arbitrary native POV, recovered native alpha or silent compatibility fallback is added.
